The '''''Nek Princess''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that once operated near [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] to recover a shipment of [[avabush spice]].
